title: 数据冒险与停顿：旁路的作用与 load-use 例外
expected_output:
=== data hazards in a 5-stage pipeline ===
  program:
    1) add r1, r2, r3
    2) sub r4, r1, r5
    3) and r6, r1, r7
    4) lw  r8, 0(r9)
    5) add r10, r8, r1
    6) or  r11, r10, r12

  --- forwarding DISABLED ---
    sub r4, r1, r5       stall 2 cycle(s): waiting for r1,r5
    add r10, r8, r1      stall 2 cycle(s): waiting for r8,r1
    or  r11, r10, r12    stall 2 cycle(s): waiting for r10,r12
    stalls per instruction: [0, 2, 0, 0, 2, 2]  (total 6)
    cycles for 6 instructions: 16   (ideal without hazards: 10)

  --- forwarding ENABLED ---
    add r10, r8, r1      stall 1 cycle(s): waiting for r8,r1
    stalls per instruction: [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0]  (total 1)
    cycles for 6 instructions: 11   (ideal without hazards: 10)

=== the take-aways ===
  forwarding lets an ALU result be consumed by the very next instruction's EX stage
  (the value already exists at the end of EX; it just has not been written back yet)

  the ONE case forwarding cannot fix is load-use:
      lw  r8, 0(r9)      <- result is only available at the end of MEM
      add r10, r8, r1    <- needs r8 at the START of its EX
  so exactly one bubble must be inserted. Compilers fill it by hoisting an
  independent instruction (instruction scheduling).

  lesson for programmers: a long chain of dependent operations cannot be parallelised
  by the hardware. Break dependency chains (multiple accumulators, reassociation)
  to let out-of-order execution overlap work.
code:
K = 5                     # IF ID EX MEM WB

# (dest, [srcs], kind)  kind: 'alu' 结果在 EX 末可用；'load' 结果在 MEM 末可用
PROG = [
    ("add r1, r2, r3",     "r1", ["r2", "r3"], "alu"),
    ("sub r4, r1, r5",     "r4", ["r1", "r5"], "alu"),   # 依赖 r1：旁路可解
    ("and r6, r1, r7",     "r6", ["r1", "r7"], "alu"),   # 依赖 r1
    ("lw  r8, 0(r9)",      "r8", ["r9"],       "load"),
    ("add r10, r8, r1",    "r10", ["r8", "r1"], "alu"),  # 依赖 lw 的 r8 -> 必须停 1 拍
    ("or  r11, r10, r12",  "r11", ["r10", "r12"], "alu"),
]

def simulate(forwarding):
    """返回 (总周期数, 每条指令的停顿数, 说明列表)"""
    ready = {}                # 寄存器 -> 结果可用的周期号（相对统一时钟）
    cycle = 0
    stalls_each = []
    notes = []
    for asm, dst, srcs, kind in PROG:
        issue = cycle
        # 所有源操作数必须在 EX 段开始前就绪
        need = issue + 2                    # 本指令 EX 段的起始周期（IF=0, ID=1, EX=2）
        wait = 0
        for s in srcs:
            if s in ready:
                avail = ready[s]
                if avail > need:
                    wait = max(wait, avail - need)
        if wait > 0:
            cycle += wait
            issue = cycle
            need = issue + 2
            notes.append("    %-20s stall %d cycle(s): waiting for %s" % (asm, wait, ",".join(srcs)))
        # 结果何时可用
        if forwarding:
            avail = issue + 3 if kind == "alu" else issue + 4    # EX末 / MEM末
        else:
            avail = issue + 5                                    # 只有写回后才可用
        ready[dst] = avail
        stalls_each.append(wait)
        cycle += 1
    return cycle + (K - 1), stalls_each, notes

print("=== data hazards in a 5-stage pipeline ===")
print("  program:")
for i, (asm, _, _, _) in enumerate(PROG, 1):
    print("    %d) %s" % (i, asm))
print()

for fwd in (False, True):
    total, stalls, notes = simulate(fwd)
    print("  --- forwarding %s ---" % ("ENABLED" if fwd else "DISABLED"))
    if notes:
        for nline in notes:
            print(nline)
    print("    stalls per instruction: %s  (total %d)" % (stalls, sum(stalls)))
    print("    cycles for %d instructions: %d   (ideal without hazards: %d)"
          % (len(PROG), total, len(PROG) + K - 1))
    print()

print("=== the take-aways ===")
print("  forwarding lets an ALU result be consumed by the very next instruction's EX stage")
print("  (the value already exists at the end of EX; it just has not been written back yet)")
print()
print("  the ONE case forwarding cannot fix is load-use:")
print("      lw  r8, 0(r9)      <- result is only available at the end of MEM")
print("      add r10, r8, r1    <- needs r8 at the START of its EX")
print("  so exactly one bubble must be inserted. Compilers fill it by hoisting an")
print("  independent instruction (instruction scheduling).")
print()
print("  lesson for programmers: a long chain of dependent operations cannot be parallelised")
print("  by the hardware. Break dependency chains (multiple accumulators, reassociation)")
print("  to let out-of-order execution overlap work.")
